docker-agent:index:UserAlias.description: An agent alias, as created by `docker agent alias add`: `docker agent run <alias>` runs `path` with the alias's defaults. Alias names may contain letters, digits, `-` and `_`, and start with a letter or digit.

hideToolResults.description: Hide tool call results in the TUI when running the alias.

model.description: Override the agent's model, in the format `[agent=]provider/model`.

path.description: The agent file path or OCI reference, for example `./agent.yaml` or `docker.io/myorg/agent:latest`.

safety.description: The safety mode used when running the alias without `--safety`/`--yolo`: `strict`, `balanced`, `restricted` or `autonomous`.

sandbox.description: Run the alias inside a Docker sandbox by default.

yolo.description: Auto-approve every tool call when running the alias. Legacy alias for `safety: autonomous`.

docker-agent:index:UserBoard.description: Configuration of the `docker agent board` Kanban TUI.

columns.description: The board pipeline. When a card moves forward into a column, the column's prompt is sent to the card's agent. Leave it unset to keep the default pipeline (Dev, Review, Push, Done).

projects.description: The repositories cards can be created against.

docker-agent:index:UserBoardColumn.description: A column of the board pipeline. Set `id`, `name` or both.

emoji.description: An emoji shown next to the name.

id.description: The column identifier. Derived from `name` when unset; must be unique.

prompt.description: The prompt sent to the card's agent when a card moves into this column.

docker-agent:index:UserBoardProject.description: A repository the board can create cards against.

agent.description: The agent reference launched for the project's cards. Defaults to the built-in root agent.

name.description: The display name shown on cards.

docker-agent:index:UserCredentialHelper.description: An external command that prints a Docker token (`DOCKER_TOKEN`) on stdout, used instead of Docker Desktop's credentials.

docker-agent:index:UserFederationAuth.description: Exchanges an external identity token for provider credentials.

identityToken.description: Where the identity token comes from.

docker-agent:index:UserGlobalSettings.description: The `settings:` block of the docker-agent user configuration: preferences that apply to every agent you run. Every field is optional; unset fields use docker-agent's defaults. See https://docs.docker.com/ai/docker-agent/configuration/user-settings/.

busySendMode.description: What happens to a message sent while the agent works (`busy_send_mode`): `steer` (default) injects it into the running turn, `queue` holds it until the turn ends.

cacheStablePrompts.description: Keep changing context (date, environment info, dynamic prompt files) out of the frozen system prompt and append chronological updates instead, which improves prompt-cache hit rates (`cache_stable_prompts`, default `false`).

expandThinking.description: Start sessions with thinking and tool blocks expanded (`expand_thinking`, default `false`).

extra.description: Additional `settings:` keys that this provider version does not model, for example settings added by a newer docker-agent. They are written verbatim (snake_case keys) and must not repeat a typed setting.

hideToolResults.description: Hide tool call results in the TUI by default (`hide_tool_results`, default `false`). Mirrors `--hide-tool-results` and the Ctrl+O toggle.

hooks.description: Global lifecycle hooks that run for every agent, in addition to the agent's own hooks, `hooks.d/` drop-ins and `--hook-*` flags.

interruptConfirmation.description: How Esc interrupts a running stream (`interrupt_confirmation`): `always` (default) asks for confirmation, `double-tap` requires pressing Esc twice within a second, `none` interrupts immediately.

keybindings.description: Remapped TUI keyboard shortcuts. docker-agent ignores unknown actions, malformed keys and conflicts with a logged warning; the provider reports them as warnings during preview.

layout.description: Sidebar position and section visibility of the TUI.

lean.description: Make the lean TUI (minimal chrome) the default for interactive runs (`lean`, default `false`).

permissions.description: Global tool permission rules, merged with the permissions of every agent and session. A global deny always wins.

renderImages.description: Render images in the TUI with the Kitty graphics protocol (`render_images`, default `true`).

restoreTabs.description: Restore previously open tabs when the TUI starts (`restore_tabs`, default `false`).

safety.description: The default safety mode for new sessions (`safety`): `strict`, `balanced`, `restricted` or `autonomous`. It beats the safety defaults declared in agent configurations; explicit `--safety`/`--yolo` flags and alias options beat it. Any other value fails docker-agent's config loading, so the provider rejects it.

showBanner.description: Show the ASCII-art startup banner in the TUI (`show_banner`, default `true`).

snapshot.description: Take automatic shadow-git snapshots at turn boundaries for every agent (`snapshot`, default `false`).

sound.description: Play a notification sound when a task succeeds or fails (`sound`, default `false`).

soundThreshold.description: Minimum task duration in seconds before a success sound plays (`sound_threshold`, default `10`). Failures always play.

splitDiffView.description: Render file-edit diffs side by side instead of unified (`split_diff_view`, default `true`).

tabTitleMaxLength.description: Maximum display length of tab titles before they are truncated (`tab_title_max_length`, default `20`).

theme.description: The TUI theme (`theme`, default `default`): a built-in theme or `~/.cagent/themes/<name>.yaml`. `auto` follows the terminal background and picks `themeDark` or `themeLight`.

themeDark.description: The theme used when `theme` is `auto` on a dark terminal (`theme_dark`, default `default`).

themeLight.description: The theme used when `theme` is `auto` on a light terminal (`theme_light`, default `default-light`).

warnOnCacheMiss.description: Warn when a model call after the first one in a session reports no cached input tokens (`warn_on_cache_miss`, default `false`).

yolo.description: Auto-approve every tool call globally (`YOLO`, default `false`). Legacy alias for `safety: autonomous`; `safety` wins when both are set.

docker-agent:index:UserHook.description: A hook: a shell command, a built-in function, an evaluator or a model call.

args.description: Arguments passed to the hook handler, for example to built-ins.

command.description: The shell command (`command` hooks) or the built-in name (`builtin` hooks).

env.description: Environment variables added for this hook only. Stored as secrets, since they often carry tokens: `yaml` and `sha256` become secret when they are set.

evaluatorPolicy.description: How a `toolGuard` evaluator hook turns assessments into decisions.

name.description: A label for logs and runtime events.

onError.description: What a hook failure does: `warn` (default), `ignore` or `block`.

prompt.description: The prompt template of a `model` hook (Go text/template over the hook input).

routingPolicy.description: How a `beforeAgentRun`/`afterAgentComplete` evaluator hook routes to agents.

schema.description: How a `model` hook's reply is interpreted, for example `pre_tool_use_decision` or `guard_decision`. Empty returns the reply as additional context.

strictOutput.description: Require JSON output and validate it against the event's capabilities.

systemPrompt.description: Overrides the default system message of a `model` hook.

type.description: The hook type: `command` (default) runs `command` in a shell, `builtin` runs the built-in function named by `command` (for example `add_date` or `redact_secrets`), `evaluator` asks a named evaluator, `model` asks an LLM.

workingDir.description: The working directory of the hook.

docker-agent:index:UserHookEvaluatorPoli.description: Maps an evaluator's assessments to tool-guard decisions.

decisions.description: Assessment outcome to decision (`allow`, `ask` or `deny`). Boolean evaluators use the keys `true` and `false`.

fallback.description: The decision when the assessment is uncertain: `ask` or `deny`.

minProbability.description: The lowest probability (greater than 0, at most 1) at which a decision applies.

docker-agent:index:UserHookMatcher.description: Hooks for the tools whose names match `matcher`.

hooks.description: The hooks to run when the matcher matches.

matcher.description: A case-sensitive regular expression over tool names, for example `shell|edit_file`. `*` matches every tool.

preemptYolo.description: Run this `preToolUse` entry before the approval pipeline, so its deny or ask verdict cannot be bypassed by any safety mode. Only valid on `preToolUse`.

docker-agent:index:UserHookRoutingPolicy.description: Maps a choice evaluator's outcomes to agents.

minProbability.description: The lowest probability (greater than 0, at most 1) at which a route applies.

docker-agent:index:UserHooks.description: Global lifecycle hooks, keyed by event. Tool events (`preToolUse`, `postToolUse`, `permissionRequest`, `toolResponseTransform`, `toolInputTransform`, `toolGuard`) take matchers that select tools by name; every other event takes a list of hooks. See https://docs.docker.com/ai/docker-agent/configuration/hooks/.

afterAgentComplete.description: Run after an agent completes and optionally route to another agent (`after_agent_complete`).

afterLlmCall.description: Run just after each successful model call (`after_llm_call`).

beforeAgentRun.description: Run once per agent activation and optionally route to another agent (`before_agent_run`).

beforeCompaction.description: Run immediately before a compaction; hooks can veto it or supply the summary (`before_compaction`).

beforeLlmCall.description: Run just before each model call (`before_llm_call`).

notification.description: Run when the agent sends a notification (`notification`).

onAgentSwitch.description: Run whenever the active agent changes (`on_agent_switch`).

onError.description: Run when the runtime hits an error during a turn (`on_error`).

onMaxIterations.description: Run when the agent reaches its `max_iterations` limit (`on_max_iterations`).

onSessionResume.description: Run when the user lets the agent continue past `max_iterations` (`on_session_resume`).

onToolApprovalDecision.description: Run after the approval chain decides on a tool call (`on_tool_approval_decision`).

onUserInput.description: Run when the agent needs user input (`on_user_input`).

permissionRequest.description: Run just before the user would be asked to approve a tool call (`permission_request`). Hooks can allow or deny without prompting.

postToolUse.description: Run after a tool completes, successfully or not (`post_tool_use`).

preCompact.description: Run before the session transcript is compacted (`pre_compact`).

preToolUse.description: Run before a tool executes (`pre_tool_use`). Hooks can block the call or rewrite its arguments.

promptFileGuard.description: Check loaded prompt-file instructions before use (`prompt_file_guard`).

skillContentGuard.description: Check raw skill text before it is expanded or delivered (`skill_content_guard`).

stop.description: Run when the model finishes responding and hands control back (`stop`).

toolGuard.description: Decide on a tool call before the approval pipeline; the verdict cannot be bypassed by any safety mode (`tool_guard`).

toolInputTransform.description: Rewrite tool arguments before the approval pipeline runs (`tool_input_transform`).

toolResponseTransform.description: Rewrite a tool's output before it is recorded (`tool_response_transform`).

turnEnd.description: Run when an agent turn finishes, for any reason (`turn_end`).

turnStart.description: Run at the start of every agent turn (`turn_start`). Output is added as transient context for that turn.

userFollowupSubmit.description: Run when a queued follow-up message starts a new turn (`user_followup_submit`).

userPromptSubmit.description: Run once per user message before the first model call of the turn (`user_prompt_submit`).

userSteeringMessagesSubmit.description: Run when messages sent while the agent was working are added to the session (`user_steering_messages_submit`).

worktreeCreate.description: Run inside a new git worktree created by `docker agent run --worktree` (`worktree_create`).

docker-agent:index:UserIdentityTokenSour.description: The source of an identity token. Set one of `file`, `env`, `command` or `url`.

command.description: Run this command (argv form) and read the token from stdout.

env.description: Read the token from this environment variable.

file.description: Read the token from this file.

headers.description: HTTP headers sent with the `url` request. Stored as secrets, since they usually carry credentials: `yaml` and `sha256` become secret when they are set.

responseField.description: The JSON field of the `url` response that holds the token.

url.description: Fetch the token from this URL.

docker-agent:index:UserKeybinding.description: Binds a TUI action to one or more keys, replacing the action's default keys.

keys.description: The key combinations in Bubble Tea format, for example `ctrl+k`, `alt+enter` or `f2`.

docker-agent:index:UserLayoutSettings.description: The TUI layout (`settings.layout`). Unset fields keep the default layout: sidebar on the right, every section except Plans visible, normal spacing.

activeAgentsOnly.description: Show only the agents active in the current session in the Agents section.

hideSessionPath.description: Hide the working directory (session path) line, including its git branch.

sectionSpacing.description: Blank space between sidebar sections: `normal` (default), `compact` or `relaxed`.

showPlans.description: Show shared plans in the sidebar (default `false`).

sidebarInfoMode.description: How the Agents section renders each agent: `compact` (default, two lines) or `detailed` (cards with effort, context and cost metrics).

sidebarPosition.description: Where the sidebar goes: `right` (default), `left`, `top` or `bottom`. Top and bottom render a compact horizontal band.

docker-agent:index:UserModel.description: A model definition with the same fields as an entry of an agent file's `models:` section. A model with only `provider` and `model` is written in the `provider/model` shorthand.

baseUrl.description: A custom API base URL. Implies `bypassModelsGateway`.

bypassModelsGateway.description: Connect directly to the provider even when a models gateway is configured.

capabilities.description: Input modalities the model supports, overriding the built-in catalog.

compactionModel.description: The model used to summarize the session during compaction.

compactionThreshold.description: The fraction of the context window (greater than 0, at most 1) at which compaction starts.

cost.description: Prices per million tokens, used for cost tracking.

firstAvailable.description: Candidate models; the first usable one is selected. Excludes most other fields.

model.description: The model name, for example `gpt-5-mini` or `claude-sonnet-4-5`.

parallelToolCalls.description: Whether parallel tool calls are enabled.

provider.description: The provider, for example `openai`, `anthropic`, `google`, `amazon-bedrock`, `dmr` or the name of a custom provider.

providerOpts.description: Provider-specific options, written verbatim (snake_case keys), for example `context_size`.

routing.description: Rules that route requests to other models based on example prompts.

taskBudget.description: Total token budget for an agentic task (Anthropic `task_budget`).

titleModel.description: The model used to generate session titles.

tokenKey.description: The name of the environment variable that holds the API token.

docker-agent:index:UserModelCost.description: Prices in USD per million tokens.

docker-agent:index:UserModelRoutingRule.description: Routes prompts similar to the examples to another model.

docker-agent:index:UserPermissions.description: Global tool permission patterns. Patterns use glob syntax, for example `shell`, `read_*`, `mcp:github:*` or `shell:cmd=git status*`. Deny is evaluated first, then allow, then ask.

ask.description: Tools that always ask, even when they are normally auto-approved.

docker-agent:index:UserProvider.description: A reusable model provider (for example an OpenAI-compatible endpoint), merged into every agent configuration docker-agent loads. Definitions in an agent file win on name conflicts.

apiType.description: The API flavour of OpenAI-compatible providers: `openai_chatcompletions` (default) or `openai_responses`.

auth.description: A non-API-key authentication scheme, such as Anthropic workload identity federation.

baseUrl.description: The API base URL. Required for OpenAI-compatible providers.

compactionModel.description: Default compaction (summary) model for agents using this provider.

maxTokens.description: Default maximum number of output tokens.

parallelToolCalls.description: Whether parallel tool calls are enabled by default.

provider.description: The underlying provider type: `openai` (default), `anthropic`, `google`, `amazon-bedrock`, `dmr` or a built-in alias.

taskBudget.description: Default total token budget for an agentic task (Anthropic `task_budget`).

thinkingBudget.description: Default reasoning effort or token budget.

tokenKey.description: The name of the environment variable that holds the API token (not the token itself).

trackUsage.description: Whether token usage is tracked by default.

unloadApi.description: Path or URL of the provider's model-unload endpoint, used by the `unload` built-in hook. Leave unset for cloud providers.

docker-agent:index:UserTaskBudget.description: A total budget for an agentic task. `0` disables it.

type.description: The budget kind. Only `tokens` (default) is supported.

docker-agent:index:UserThinkingBudget.description: A reasoning budget. Set exactly one of `effort` and `tokens`.

tokens.description: A token budget. `0` disables thinking, `-1` lets the provider decide.

flavors.description: Named YAML patches applied on top of the rest of the document when enabled at run time (e.g. 'docker agent run --flavor <name>'). Each flavor is a partial config document merged with JSON Merge Patch semantics: objects merge recursively, scalars and arrays replace, null deletes a key. A key ending in '+' appends its items to the existing array (e.g. 'toolsets+:'); a scalar existing value is promoted to a one-element array first, so 'instruction+:' extends a string instruction. A key ending in '-' removes entries — from an object by key name, from an array by scalar equality or partial object match (e.g. 'toolsets-: [{type: shell}]'). Enabled flavors are applied in the order they were requested; requested flavors not defined here are ignored. Each flavor is a free-form YAML patch with the same structure as the configuration (snake_case keys), rendered verbatim.
